item.title: This One-Off Bugatti Mistral Boasts a Drool-Worthy Paint Job
item.description: The 'La Perle Rare' is the latest project from Bugatti's Sur Mesure customization division, with this Mistral wearing an exquisite white-and-gold color combo.

item.title: De Tomaso Reveals Magnificent V-12 That'll Power Its New P900 Hypercar
item.description: This exotic naturally aspirated 7.0-liter engine makes 900 horsepower, redlines at 10,200 rpm, and likely sounds glorious.

item.title: Tuners Finally Unlock the C8 Corvette ZR1's ECM and Find Nearly 1200 HP
item.description: HP Tuners cracked the engine control module for GM's LT6 and LT7 V-8s, and then a modded ZR1 registered 1180 horsepower at the wheels.
